diagnostics.message: aws_s3_bucket_policy.action_dist_bucket_policy attaches a policy to the action-distribution bucket, but has no ordering relationship with aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.action_dist, which sets block_public_policy = true. When the public access block has not yet been applied, AWS evaluates the bucket without those settings and can reject the PutBucketPolicy call (or briefly allow a wider window than intended). The public access block must be in place before the bucket policy is attached — this operational ordering is not expressed by any attribute reference or depends_on.
